thread:
linh_csm: Seabright (NZ pilot) asks for an emergency demo lift tomorrow 09:30 NZT. Need: temporary regional edge allowlist for partner IPs, QPS bump to 2000 on route 'seabright-demo', and client cert pinning. ETA: 3.5h window. cc @raj_sre @morgan_net

raj_sre: Copy. Two quick checks: 1) public egress IPs? 2) sustained or spikey traffic? If sustained we need to reserve burst capacity on Dedicated pools.

morgan_net: They provided egress list: 203.0.113.10/32, 203.0.113.11/32. Traffic is bursty (many short requests), with a few websocket long-poll calls. Also they want TLS SNI pinning to demo.seabright.ai.

kevin_support: Legal cleared the demo terms but flagged data residency—will only allow AU/NZ region traffic. Can we ensure routing stays in au-syd/au-north?

ops_bot: Note: regional pinning rule available: route-level region_restriction attribute. Temporary allowlists default to 48h unless 'extend' is requested. Cert storage: upload to secrets manager via UI or API. Example CLI to create allowlist + region pin:
```
redwoodctl allowlist create --name seabright-temp --cidrs 203.0.113.10/32,203.0.113.11/32 --expires 2026-04-05T02:30:00Z --regions au-southeast-2 --note "Seabright NZ demo; auto-expire"
redwoodctl route update --route seabright-demo --qps 2000 --region_pin au-southeast-2
```

raj_sre: I'll provision the allowlist and set QPS override. For Dedicated fallback: reserving a small burst slab (2x baseline) while demo runs. Ticket CS-4622. Will also enable header-based routing for SNI pinning.

deploy-bot: Triggered rollout: edge-config-canary #3892 -> started. Canary window 5m.

linh_csm: Partner just confirmed cert CN: demo.seabright.ai and will upload pem to our portal in next 10 mins. Also asked if we can mute quota alerts for this window to avoid noisy pages.

raj_sre: We can set alert suppress rule scoped to CS-4622 for the window. I'll only suppress P0 alerts if errors <5% and latency <200ms. Otherwise auto-revoke.

ops_bot: Allowlist created: AL-10021 (203.0.113.10/32,203.0.113.11/32) expires 2026-04-05T02:30:00Z. Route override applied: seabright-demo qps=2000 region_pin=au-southeast-2. Alert suppression set for ticket CS-4622.

morgan_net: Canary looks good; no cert handshake errors. Rolling change to prod edge in 3m.

kevin_support: Noted on data residency confirmation. I'll log the renewal signal: pilot onboarding speed + positive demo => touch for renewal + regional compliance.

linh_csm: Thanks team. I'll send customer the connection details, cert upload confirmation, and rollback criteria (we'll revoke allowlist & revert qps if errors exceed 5% or 95th p50 latency >250ms).

raj_sre: All set. Linked deploy logs in CS ticket. Auto-revoke scheduled at expiry. Close loop unless we need extension.

linh_csm: Closing the loop after the demo. Appreciate the quick turnaround, everyone. :rocket:
